name: envision-technologies-api
description: Connect your Envision account to consult permitted accounts, execution history, market reports and data, portfolios, tasks and documents. Administrators can inspect a dated architecture inventory, review account reconciliation and preview positions without submitting orders, and manage permitted CRM, tasks, documents and simulations. Access depends on your current Envision role, connection permissions and resource ownership or sharing. Installation alone grants no data access. This integration does not execute broker trades, move money or operate servers. Codex administrators with authorized local filesystem access can optionally consult their own envision_brain checkout through the bundled skill; private Brain documentation is not included.

positive.prompt: List the Envision capabilities available to my connection.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists capabilities available to the synthetic review identity without claiming additional permissions.

positive.prompt: List the accounts I can access in Envision.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only fictional review accounts, such as DEMO-ALPHA, without production data.

positive.prompt: Summarize the latest daily market report and state its date.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the synthetic review report and names its source date.

positive.prompt: Find my prospect review-owned-prospect and summarize its next steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the owned fictional prospect and accurately describes its next steps.

positive.prompt: List my Envision tasks and identify the next due item.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only tasks visible to the synthetic review identity with their recorded dates.
